What this means we would like to explain to you! And to do this properly, we will first give you some more information about the product made at your new employer.As a production assistant measuring equipment, you will help make these devices. To arrive at the final product, the device passes through several stations. You can be deployed at the Programming, Sticking and Packaging stations. At the Programming station, you ensure that the desired configuration is loaded onto the device. You use a computer for this and you are good with it. At the next station, you stick a label on the device. This makes it clear to which customer the device is to be sent. At the last station, the devices are packed and prepared for shipment. The work is until the end of December.Over de opdrachtgeverYour new employer is an expert in making measuring devices for transport.
